lcc_original: 你呢、你要拿所喫的各樣食品，積聚起來，這就要做你和牠們的食物。』
notes: LCC's emphatic 你呢、你... renders Hebrew אַתָּה; WAH0859 tags the first 你 (the emphatic subject), the second 你 is Chinese-style repetition and left unannotated
LCC 所喫的 explicitly renders the three UNV implicit tags {<WAH0834>}{<WH0398>}{<WTH8735>}; braces dropped per Rule 3 since 所 (relativizer = אֲשֶׁר) and 喫 (= יֵאָכֵל) are both explicit in LCC
LCC's connective 這 in 這就要做 has no direct Hebrew counterpart and is left unannotated
食物 (UNV) → 食品 (LCC) synonym substitution; WH03978 placed on 食品
